landing.t1I4: Test the power of AI and see for yourself
landing.t2D: A starting step for owners of a small auto tuning shop.
landing.t3D: For owners of a large auto tuning shop or a professional tuning salon.
landing.t3I2: The most optimal choice in the system
landing.t3I3: Access from up to 8 devices at once
landing.rv1t: We show customers their car on new wheels — the deal closes on the spot. Our sales have grown noticeably.
landing.rv2t: Choosing wrap colours now takes minutes. Customers see the result and order without hesitation.
landing.rv3t: A great tool for my videos. The 4K render quality is no different from a real photo.
landing.rv4t: I saw the body kit before installing it and did not make a mistake. A very convenient, premium experience.
landing.apSub: Download our app — photograph your car and see its new look in seconds.
landing.f1q: How close is the 4K result to the real parts?
landing.f1a: Our neural network accounts for light, reflections and shadows and produces a result almost indistinguishable from a real photograph.
landing.f2q: How does the 3% deposit protect the owner and the workshop?
landing.f2a: The deposit reserves the parts in stock and is held safely until the work is done — both sides are protected.
landing.f3q: What if the photo is blurry or dark?
landing.f3a: The system checks the quality automatically and advises you on retaking the photo.
landing.f4q: Can studios upload their own inventory?
landing.f4a: Yes, on the Pro and Enterprise plans you can sync your own parts and stock.
landing.ftTagline: Turn your car into a masterpiece with the power of AI.
